text:
incident-bot: Pager — elevated GPU OOM rate on s-prod-serving-02 (pool: genai-large). Multiple container restarts detected. Impact: increased 500s and failed streaming. Paging alex (oncall) and eng-sre.

alex (oncall): Saw it. on it. beginning triage. any customer-facing impact yet? :eyes:

tanya (cs): Customers reporting chat hangs and `internal_error` on large-context endpoint. Two enterprise customers (acme-co, finpulse) filed errors ~5m ago. CS has notified them we are investigating.

maria (runtime): Logs show repeated CUDA OOM during prefill sequence for long prompts (~200k tokens combined). Container restart loop repeated ~3-8x per pod. snippet:
```
E tensorflow: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 3.2GiB (GPU 0; 40.0GiB total)
at runtime/prefill.cc:142 handle_prefill()
containerd: exit code 139
```

liam (infra): Node metrics — GPU mem pressure spikes correlate with prefill latencies. s-prod-serving-02 has 6/8 pods crashing, node load climbing. No full node crash yet but flapping containers. I've cordoned node and started draining non-critical pods.

james (eng-sre): Good call cordon. Can we throttle long-context requests at gateway quickly? We need a short-term mitigation to stop new prefill heavy requests to that pool.

maria (runtime): We can flip routing rule to send large-context requests to fallback pool (genai-medium) or degrade to truncated-prefill mode. Quick command to set policy below (will apply in ~30s):
```
# temp route to fallback pool for requests with context_tokens > 65536
redwood route update --name large-context --condition "context_tokens>65536" --target genai-medium
```

alex (oncall): Do that now. Also enable per-pod restart backoff to avoid tight crash loops.

deploy-bot: Route update job queued (job-id: 98b2). Rolling change across ingesters.

maria (runtime): Route update applied. Observability: prefix request rate to genai-large dropped ~70% in 45s. Crash rate on s-prod-serving-02 dropping. Also toggled truncated-prefill=true for genai-large as extra protection.

liam (infra): Draining reduced new pods on the node; restarted surviving pods with increased --max-prefill-bytes=1500000000 to add cushion (temporary). Will monitor GPU allocs.

tanya (cs): Notifying impacted customers: told them we throttled very long contexts and will follow up with ETA for full fix. They asked for rollback to previous behavior if no regressions — noted.

james (eng-sre): Initial impact summary: ~2.3% request error increase cluster-wide during spike window, ~12% error rate for requests >100k tokens to genai-large. Affected ~4% of dedicated customers on that pool. No data loss, only transient 5xxs and session restarts.

alex (oncall): Current status: gateways routing long contexts away, node cordoned, crash loops reduced. Plan: 1) keep routing rule for 2 hours, 2) patch runtime to enforce prefill soft-cap and fall back to streaming-prefill (PR in progress by maria), 3) postmortem / customer notes.

maria (runtime): Working on hotfix: enforce prefill allocation accounting and early-kill if predicted prefill > threshold, fallback to truncation with a clear error code. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/442

james (eng-sre): Will follow up with post-incident monitoring alert to detect similar patterns and auto-route in future. Also adding a canary check for prefill with synthetic long prompt every deploy.

tanya (cs): I'll draft customer impact emails for acme-co and finpulse with timeline + mitigations.

alex (oncall): Thanks all. Keeping channel open for 30m to verify stability, then will escalate to postmortem if changes stick. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident note — severity: SEV3 (partial service degradation), start_ts=1758234560, current_state=mitigated_by_routing_change.

maria (runtime): Follow-ups (short): 1) land PR 442 and rollout to canaries, 2) add prefill token gating in routing rules, 3) update docs for recommended max_context per model. Longer: run charge-level tests for mixed prefill+streaming workloads.

alex (oncall): last update before we close incident channel: crash rate stable <1% and customer errors reduced. handing to james for postmortem and to tanya for customer comms. Thanks team.

james (eng-sre): Taking postmortem ownership. Will ping when draft ready. closing live pager but leaving thread for follow-ups.
